shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx && printf '\\n--- shell ---\\n' && cat shell.nix && printf '\\n--- index ---\\n' && cat index.html && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- dependencies ---\\n' && rg '\"@gravity-ui' package-lock.json | head -30 && printf '\\n--- exported toast components ---\\n' && rg 'export .*Toast|Toaster|useToaster|toaster' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && printf '\\n' && sort -t_ -k2 -V java/ru/oxbuy/oneye/*.kt | sed -n '1,140p' && printf '\\n--- res/values ---\\n' && cat res/values/strings.xml && printf '\\n--- res/drawable ---\\n' && cat res/drawable/ic_launcher_background.xml && cat res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml && printf '\\n--- res/menu ---\\n' && cat res/menu/vcs_menu.xml && printf '\\n--- manifest ---\\n' && cat AndroidManifest.xml && printf '\\n--- build ---\\n' && cat build.gradle && printf '\\n--- CI ---\\n' && cat .github/workflows/android.yml"

/bin/bash -lc "cat index.html && printf '\\n--- Toast props ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/types.d.ts && printf '\\n--- provider API ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/*.d.ts && printf '\\n--- Button/Icon API ---\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && rg 'ToasterProvider|ToasterComponent' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -40 && printf '\\n--- provider ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.js && printf '\\n--- component ---\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToasterComponent/*.js && printf '\\n--- CSS ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.css"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -l \"g-root toaster|toaster\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -g '*.css' | head -40 && printf '\\n--- common tsc build? ---\\n' && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList && printf '\\n--- provider dts full ---\\n' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ToastList/ToastList.css && printf '\\n--- CSS common data ---\\n' && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -iname '*.css' | head -5 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && printf '\\n--- git status/log ---\\n' && git status --short && git log --oneline -5"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts && printf '\\n--- icon inventory sample ---\\n' && rg 'export .*Bell|export .*Info' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30 && printf '\\n--- lock git diff ---\\n' && git diff -- package-lock.json | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules -path '*@gravity-ui/icons*' -prune -print | head -30 && find node_modules/.pnpm -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '*gravity-ui*' 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true && rg \"icons\" package-lock.json | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm 2>/dev/null | head -50 && rg 'export \\{ default as Bell' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons -g '*.js' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg 'Button.Icon|<Button' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button -g '*.js' | head -40 && printf '\\n--- sample button interface ---\\n' && rg 'forwardRef\\(function (Button|ButtonIcon)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button -g '*.js' -C 3 | head -40 && printf '\\n--- use mobile / portal ---\\n' && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Portal/Portal.js"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- package changes ---\\n' && git status --short"
